speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; this suggests jaundice. To determine the severity and cause, can you tell me how many days old your baby is and when you first noticed the yellowing?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (likely insufficient intake) or early onset of breast milk jaundice; however, given the age of 2 weeks with worsening yellowing, I must rule out biliary atresia. REQUEST TEST: Bilirubin_levels (Total and Direct). REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_ultrasound.
